incidents.SUMMARY: The governed pre-migration verified backup (backup 2026-10-02_183040-c54f8cb8) completed its 2h07m dump, then failed before any database mutation at the first digest query with: snapshot does not exist (CRITICAL_DIGEST_QUERY_FAILED:trade.decision). Production stayed at schema 067.
incidents.ROOT_CAUSE: The exported snapshot is held by one idle psql session in an open transaction for the whole dump. That session disappeared between 20:37:50Z (dump complete) and 20:42:00Z (failure). Two candidate causes, not distinguishable from the persisted evidence: (1) a long-idle connection reaped on the network path; (2) a transient server-side connectivity event: ops.runtime_worker_cycle recorded a POSTGRES_57P03 (cannot_connect_now) failure at 20:41:47Z, 13 s before the backup failed. The server idle_in_transaction_session_timeout is 1 day and pg_postmaster_start_time is unchanged (2026-09-22), so an idle-transaction timeout and a full restart are ruled out.
incidents.FIX_SHA: 3158c61 (heartbeat keeps the keeper active and records its death) and the Assert-ThetaSnapshotKeeperAlive commit (fails the backup immediately after the dump with the real cause)
incidents.FIX_LIMITS: The heartbeat addresses cause (1) only. It cannot keep a snapshot alive across a server-side connection loss (cause 2). A keeper that dies during a multi-hour dump still forces a rerun; the new assertion makes that failure immediate and explicit. Possible further hardening (not yet implemented): run the digest queries and the schema dump before the long custom dump so the snapshot only needs to survive minutes.
incidents.CURRENT_STATUS: MITIGATED_NOT_ELIMINATED: heartbeat and early detection shipped on the branch; confirmation requires a governed backup that completes.
